tools.name: generate_document
tools.description: Statelessly synthesize a vector PDF document (invoice, receipt, contract, NDA, or lease) in <25ms without mutating server records. Example: doc_type='invoice', generate_document({"doc_type":"invoice","from":{"name":"Acme"},"to":{"name":"Client"}})

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Statelessly render a 144-PPI PNG preview of a document as a Base64 data URI without mutating server records. Example: doc_type='invoice' or preview_document({"doc_type":"invoice","from":{"name":"Acme"},"to":{"name":"Client"}})

tools.name: calculate_totals
tools.description: Statelessly compute subtotal, tax, discount, grand total, and balance due for a document payload without mutating server records. Example: tax_rate=8.25 or calculate_totals({"document":{"items":[{"quantity":2,"unit_price":50}]}})

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read static subscription tiers, single-pass unlocks, and checkout links without mutating server records. Example: currency='USD' or get_pricing({})

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Stateless in-memory conversion and PDF synthesis from Estimate/Quote JSON to Invoice, Receipt, or Credit Note without mutating server records. Example: target_type='invoice', convert_document({"document":{},"target_type":"invoice"})

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Stateless in-memory payment calculation and PDF synthesis returning a Receipt or partial-payment Invoice without mutating server records. Example: amount_paid=100, record_payment({"document":{},"amount_paid":100})

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
